main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). A spacious 1,800m Victorian Gippsland oval with a 350m home straight. The track features long back-stretch chutes for 1000m, 1200m, and 1600m events, allowing horses time to balance up before the first turn.
main_turf.post_bias: On Good/Soft ground, inside barriers (stalls 1–4) hold a ground-saving advantage in sprint events. On Heavy 8+ tracks, the inside rail deteriorates and jockey bias shifts wide toward the center of the track on the home turn.

handicapping_angles.gippsland_and_metro_shippers: Bairnsdale attracts top Victorian Provincial and Metropolitan yards (Cranbourne, Pakenham, Mornington) seeking confidence-boosting wins. Heavily upgrade shippers coming off Cranbourne or Pakenham provincial maiden and BM58 form (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.350m_straight_pace_balance: On Good 4 / Soft 5 surfaces, tactical pressers ('P') and prominent leaders ('E') holding position into the 350m home straight are tough to catch. On wet tracks, upgrade fit 'Swoopers' (closers) coming wide off the turn.
handicapping_angles.bairnsdale_cup_carnival: During the annual Bairnsdale Cup carnival in October, field quality rises significantly. Treat Cup day feature form as higher-tier provincial grade.
